_comment: The seven Common Actions from rulebook 6.1 (book p.91), plus the Remote Access Universal Action every Mech gains from 5.3.3. Every Mech has these in addition to the Actions printed on its Parts, so a squad's real options are its Part Actions plus whichever of these its surviving Parts can initiate. They are not in cards.json because they are not printed on any card, so they are transcribed here by hand. The printed rulebook always wins over this file.
_shape: Each entry mirrors a CardAction closely enough to be merged into the guided action list: id, name, type (the Action Type, matching the card data's spelling), size (s = Short = 1 Action Tick, m = Medium = 2 Action Ticks), and the Part slots that can initiate it. Every one of them is performed in an Action Opportunity: the book prints Reveal, Stabilize System and Scan with the Tactical (hourglass) Short Action icon on p.91, so none is an End Phase action.
_source: rules/06_missions_and_appendix.md section 6.1, transcribed from book p.91

actions.requires: a Part whose Action carries the Charge icon

description.en:
· Silence.
· Performed by one or more Parts with an Action that has the Charge Icon: that Action becomes Charged.

actions.requires: a Part with the Handheld entry

description.en:
· Silence.
· Performed by one or more Parts with the Handheld entry: the Part switches to the Discard State.

· Melee Attack: 2 red dice.
· Performed with Chassis, Left Arm or Right Arm.
· A Melee Action, so it gives Melee Lock (4.3.5).

· Performed with Chassis, Left Arm or Right Arm.
· Cannot be used to Break Away.
· The unit becomes Revealed and performs Manifestation Movement.

· Silence.
· Performed with Torso: remove 1 Square Token or 1 Hexagon Token from this Unit, then Restore 1 Link.

· Range 4. Performed with Torso.
· Electronic Counter-roll against the Terminal (Electronic Value 3). If successful, the Terminal is Accessed.
· Each Terminal may be accessed once per round.

· Silence. Range 6. Performed with Torso.
· Designate an enemy Unit in the Optical Camouflage State or bearing a Low Profile Token.
· Electronic Counter-roll against the target. If successful: a target in the Optical Camouflage State is Revealed; a target bearing Low Profile Tokens removes them.

extraTicks.condition: while this Mech acts during the Firing Timing

_overload: The OCSP Overloading Pack buys ordinary Action Ticks with Link. Ordinary matters: two of them pay for one Medium Action, which no pair of Extra Ticks can do. Only the binding to the printed Action lives here; the limit of two is the rule and lives in the tick engine.
_text: Descriptions are the printed rule and nothing else: no designer notes, no FAQ commentary (OTTO, 2026-09-17). The fifth Common Action is |Crawl| (Moving, Medium, R 1; Chassis, Left Arm or Right Arm; cannot be used to Break Away), checked against the printed book by OTTO on 2026-09-21. It was carried for months as 'Punch / Kick (movement)' with an invented 1-Grid shove; the book prints neither the name nor any shove. Range 1 rides in the `range` field. The Break Away bar needs no code: leaving a Melee Lock costs at least +1 Movement Range and Crawl has 1.
